column3: NASB supplies “Jesus” and adds “every kind of.”
NASB follows the critical text with “Thaddaeus” alone; “Lebbaeus, who was called” is from the Textus Receptus.
“The perishing sheep” is rendered “the lost sheep.”
NASB renders “proclaim” as “preach” and “has drawn near” as “is at hand.”
“Take along” is rendered “acquire,” and “belts” is “money belts.”
NASB adds “at his house” and “that city.”
NASB renders “your peace” as “your blessing of peace” and recasts the clauses as commands to give and take back.
NASB renders “courts” (sanhedrins) as “the courts” and “flog” as “scourge.”
“Deliver up” is rendered “betray,” and “put them to death” is “cause them to be put to death.”
“Flee to the other” is rendered “flee to the next”; NASB adds “going through.”
NASB renders “master of the house” as “head of the house” and adds “will they malign.”
“What you hear in the ear” is rendered “what you hear whispered in your ear.”
NASB renders the coin “assarion” as “a cent” and adds “and yet.”
